content_sections.heading: SKAU Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026 Nationality/Eligibility Conditions
content_sections.text: A candidate applying for SKAU Recruitment 2026 must be either: A citizen of India, or A subject of Nepal, or A subject of Bhutan, or A Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries of Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, and Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates belonging to the Nepal, Bhutan, Tibetan refugee, or migrant categories above must possess a certificate of eligibility issued by the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: SKAU Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: As per the Service Rules, no candidate who has not attained the age of 18 years shall be appointed to any post in the University, and the candidate should not be more than 42 years of age as on the last date of application. Relaxation in the maximum age for various categories will be given as per Haryana Government instructions No. 22/06/2021-1GS-III dated 25.03.2022, issued by the General Administration Department, Government of Haryana, as amended from time to time. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: SKAU Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies by post and is generally conducted in two or three phases, based on a total merit of 100 marks. A summary of the selection process for each post is given below. For posts with negative marking (Assistant Registrar and SDE Civil), 0.25 marks are deducted for each incorrect answer, and no marks are awarded or deducted for an unanswered question. For all other posts, no marks are deducted for an incorrect or unanswered question. Shortlisting for Physical Document Verification and subsequent stages is generally done in a post-wise/category-wise ratio of 1:5, based on merit determined from the Written Test and provisional Academic Achievement marks taken together. In case of a tie, candidates are ranked first by age (older candidate senior), then by alphabetical order of name, and finally by alphabetical order of father's name.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SKAU Kurukshetra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date for registration, filling/submission of the online application (including uploading of documents) and fee payment is 26.10.2026, up to 04:00 PM. The signed, downloaded copy of the application form must be uploaded by 29.10.2026, 12:00 midnight.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies across 8 posts: Assistant Registrar, SDE (Civil), JE (Civil), JE (Electrical), Library Assistant, Library Counter Clerk, Library Restorer, and Store Keeper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee ranges from NIL (for PwBD candidates of Haryana with at least 40% disability) to Rs. 1,500 for male General category candidates and candidates from other states. Female General category candidates of Haryana pay Rs. 750, and OSC/DSC/BC-A/BC-B (Non-Creamy Layer)/ESM/EWS category candidates of Haryana pay Rs. 375.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and not more than 42 years old as on the last date of application, with age relaxation applicable as per Haryana Government instructions for various categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for SKAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process differs by post but generally includes a Written Test (MCQ-based), assessment of Academic Achievement based on Physical Document Verification, and, for certain posts such as Assistant Registrar and SDE (Civil), a Computer Skill Test and Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there negative marking in the SKAU Recruitment 2026 written test?
faq.answer: Negative marking of 0.25 marks per incorrect answer applies only to the Assistant Registrar and SDE (Civil) posts. For all other posts, there is no negative marking for incorrect or unanswered questions.
